title: Round 4 (v4): nonlinear information-ceiling test for genotype-specific exposure (G2F + BRIWECS)
status: FROZEN before analysis. Motivation declared: linear oracle tests found no headroom (G2F -0.0102; BRIWECS +0.0015, dEC penalty at grid edge). This round asks whether a flexible nonlinear learner extracts information from oracle-aligned exposure deviations (dEC) that ridge missed. Earlier verdicts are unchanged.

datasets_and_splits.G2F: forward test years 2019, 2020, 2021 exactly as round 1 (77 test envs)
datasets_and_splits.BRIWECS: forward test years 2018, 2019 exactly as round 3 (23 test envs)

stage1_base: M0plus exactly as previously specified per dataset (G2F: round-1 spec with its selected penalties; BRIWECS: round-3 spec with its selected penalties); produces base predictions for test rows and CROSS-FITTED residuals for training rows (5-fold GroupKFold by environment within the training years, base refit per fold with the same penalties)

stage2_learners.learner: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor fitted to stage-1 cross-fitted training residuals
stage2_learners.NL_noDEC_features: PC1..10, predicted maturity z, EC_env (G2F 21 / BRIWECS 12)
stage2_learners.NL_DEC_features: NL_noDEC features + oracle dEC_ij (observed-phenology-aligned EC minus EC_env; same variables)

hyperparameter_grid.max_iter: early stopping on the last training year (patience 20, max 1000)

stage2_learners.selection: grid point and iteration count chosen by mean within-env Pearson of (base + stage2) on the last training year, stage-2 fitted on the remaining training years; then refit stage 2 on all training years with the chosen settings

predictions: final prediction = base prediction + stage-2 prediction
metric: within-env Pearson of hybrid/cultivar means, equal-weight mean over test envs per dataset; paired env bootstrap 2000, seed 20260928
secondary_contrasts: r(NL_noDEC) - r(M0plus): nonlinear G x E on env-level ECs

decision.NONLINEAR_HEADROOM: primary contrast >= 0.01 AND CI lower > 0 in at least one dataset -> genotype-specific exposure reopened for model development (prediction-time phenology would then need its own prereg)
decision.NO_HEADROOM: otherwise -> extrapolative G x E via genotype-specific exposure closed at the information level for G2F and BRIWECS
decision.secondary_note: if NL_noDEC - M0plus >= 0.01 with CI lower > 0, report as evidence of nonlinear env-level G x E headroom (informs step 3/level 2-3), without reopening A

reporting_rules: results frozen as JSON with sha256
